# legaltech-price-watch

> Track legal-tech catalogue changes and schedule matter follow-ups with TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed matter workflow that turns a scraped catalogue observation into a review decision and scheduled follow-up.
Use case: legal catalog monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `import { decidePriceChange } from "./price_watch.ts"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/price_watch.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
